product_milestone: evidence timing prerequisite for phase history, NOT completion of phase reconstruction
localizer: reuse unchanged legacy discovery/threshold for seed only; use raw observed interval transitions and original confirmation guards to localize; full original confirmation window required; preserve all qualifying alternatives and abstain on ambiguity
threshold_policy: no new learned thresholds; inherit legacy relative-speed threshold,1.1 multiplier,.65 support fraction,.9s support window; max gap from existing EventExtractionConfig; default unchanged
search_extent: existing Gaussian finite kernel support around selected seed, not a hand-tuned real timing offset
point_candidate: right endpoint of first unsmoothed observed high-speed interval; not exact world-motion onset or switch

acceptance.abrupt_cases: available; no point earlier than generation onset minus1ms; lag<=one dt+1ms; observation interval contains independent onset
acceptance.acceleration: available; no point before world onset minus1ms; lag<=1s; report threshold-onset semantics, no world-onset interval guarantee
acceptance.nonidentifiable_cases: UNKNOWN for no motion/no demand, nonstop without restart, isolated spike, observation gap, clipped confirmation, conflicting duplicate, empty
acceptance.sine_witness: no early point; lag<=dt+1ms versus independent onset20s
acceptance.all: physical state UNKNOWN; no lamp probability; input immutability; names do not encode topology; legacy outputs unchanged

real_check_policy: only after synthetic gate pass and code/config seal; one fixed cohort seven saved tracks; all cases reported, no tuning after development comparison; old source predictions preserved
pause_scope: do not restart phase decoder/likelihood/prior/K experiments
